principles: Every BASIC question must have a clear decision, safety, or personalization purpose.
Every rule must declare required_questions, optional_questions, and safety_questions.
A rule cannot produce a strong result when required user data is missing.
Symptoms are supporting factors, not proof of deficiency.
Conditional questions should minimize user burden.
PRO questions may deepen uncertainty identified during BASIC.
A question may exist without currently being used by a rule only while in draft.

BASIC.goal: Fast, deterministic, safe initial orientation without AI.
BASIC.expected_character: Short, mostly universal with conditional branches.

PRO.goal: Deeper personalized assessment, potentially AI-assisted and paid.
PRO.expected_character: Adaptive follow-up questions, more detailed clinical/contextual data.
